edits_on_commit: the absolute checkout prefix was stripped from every path, leaving repo-relative paths
_committed_as.found_at: the untracked .omx/physics-gate/ runtime directory of a working checkout; the producers write there, so a clean clone has no copy and this is the first committed one
what_it_does_not_carry: the rfx commit it was produced at
the S arrays themselves: candidate_artifact and reference_artifact name .npz files that were never committed, so only the metrics survive
_committed_as.why_it_is_here: the pre-declaration lists the repository's recorded openEMS lumped PEC-box magnitude comparison as CONTEXT for stage 3d. It is on a different fixture (a two-port 50 ohm PEC box at 0.8-1.8 GHz, dx = 5 mm) from this battery's parallel-plate line, and this battery compares nothing against it. Its own completion_decision says what it may not be used for.
